featured_reviews.review_text:
I thought DISCRIMINATION didn't exist anymore, until i visited "As You WON'T Like It Saloon" An apt example of what happens when money mongers with zero inter-personal skills, zero manners and zero sense of consumer inclusivity, hire employment agency dropouts from their native state as "stylists" and try to run unisex beauty salon on a semi encroached commercial unit in the glamour lanes of Juhu Versova Link Road.

One such dropout working here, is a young kid named after a global superstar who knows nothing beyond hair washing, conditioning, trimming, yet mid hair wash he was wishfully trying to upsell me hair spa despite knowing about my fever, and blow dry (even I knew blow drying wouldn't lead to the style I wanted) Finally after wasting 1.5 hours the "stylist" gave up and a little older kid named after a B'town superstar took over and put me through hair wash again.

Upon reprimanding, the younger kid zoomed off to hide his face while the older one received a rush of temper and tried to misbehave and manhandle to the extent that my phone that's costlier than his annual income had almost dropped until I rebalanced it.

Thankfully there was intervention by the owner who sat beyond the door with his personal circle, and i was expecting things to be handled now. But he had hardly finished speaking his 5th or 6th sentence and I understood where the actual problem lied. I was just beginning to wonder who these decade old loyal customers are whom the owner just boasted about, until I looked around and realized they have always had a curtain clad crowd.

Something that I was never privy to despite having paid them 6 visits in 3 months and 15k+ towards services, was put to my face in the most unpleasant, discriminating, undemocratic manner.

What I wanted vs. What I got:

Wanted a head massage for a bad headache from a 3 day long fever. Vs. Got another HEADACHE before I left from there.

Hair wash but not more than once because fever vs. Made to get hair washed THRICE.

Hair style as specified by me vs. absolute disaster.

Hair cut as per specified style vs. ends trimming.

I can go on, but I'll stop here and let my legal team take over.
